title: A Composition-Aware Pretraining Framework for Geospatial Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.30817v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Geospatial foundation models have emerged as state-of-the-art methods for downstream Earth observation tasks. However, existing pretraining methodologies process imagery through a single-concept lens, failing to capture the highly compositional nature of complex satellite scenes. We propose a composition-aware pretraining framework that explicitly encodes fractional land-cover mixtures. Each satellite image cell is mapped to a histogram representing its fractional land-cover distribution, which we term the "composition target". These targets serve as the primary prediction objective and are distilled into the backbone using Earth Mover's Distance. translated_title: 面向地理空间基础模型的组合感知预训练框架
translated_abstract: 地理空间基础模型已成为下游地球观测任务的最先进方法。然而，现有的预训练方法以单一概念的视角处理图像，未能捕捉复杂卫星场景的高度组合特性。我们提出了一种组合感知的预训练框架，显式地编码部分土地覆盖混合比例。每个卫星图像单元被映射为一个表示其土地覆盖占比分布的直方图，我们称之为“组合目标”。这些目标作为主要预测目标，并通过推土机距离蒸馏到骨干网络中。实验评估表明，组合感知预训练在需要语义相似性判断的区域级理解任务上带来了显著提升，包括零样本图像检索和场景分类，同时在需要细粒度空间（理解）的任务上仍保持竞争力。
tldr: 提出一种组合感知的预训练框架，将卫星图像映射为土地覆盖组成直方图作为预测目标，并利用推土机距离将其蒸馏到骨干网络中，从而在零样本图像检索和场景分类等区域级理解任务上取得显著提升。
en_tdlr: A composition-aware pretraining framework that maps satellite imagery to land-cover composition histograms as prediction targets and distills them into the backbone via Earth Mover's Distance, yielding substantial gains on region-level understanding tasks such as zero-shot image retrieval and scene classification.
